name: RICH-ART
aliases: Radiation Induced Cystitis treated with Hyperbaric oxygen—A Randomised controlled Trial
question: Does hyperbaric oxygen therapy improve patient-reported urinary symptoms compared with standard care in chronic radiation-induced cystitis?

design.population: Adults aged 18–80 years referred to Nordic hyperbaric clinics with symptomatic late radiation cystitis, pelvic radiotherapy at least six months earlier, and EPIC urinary total score below 80.
design.description: Five-center, open-label, phase 2–3 randomized superiority trial

verdictNote: The patient-reported urinary score improved more with hyperbaric oxygen at 6–8 months.
takeaway: In chronic radiation cystitis, hyperbaric oxygen therapy improved EPIC urinary total score more than standard care at 6–8 months: mean change 17.8 versus 7.7 points, a 10.1-point difference (95% CI 2.2–18.1).

reports.label: Initial randomized comparison
reports.citation: Oscarsson N, Müller B, Rosén A, et al. "Radiation-induced cystitis treated with hyperbaric oxygen therapy (RICH-ART): a randomised, controlled, phase 2-3 trial." *Lancet Oncol.* 2019;20(11):1602-1614. doi:10.1016/S1470-2045(19)30494-2
reports.followUp: Visit 4 at 6–8 months; median 234 days after randomization with hyperbaric oxygen and 217 days with standard care

results.measure: Mean change from baseline to visit 4 at 6–8 months; between-group mean difference in points
results.note: Modified intention-to-treat analysis excluded eight immediate post-randomization consent withdrawals (one experimental, seven control).

harms.label: Transient grade 1–2 sight- or hearing-related adverse events during hyperbaric oxygen therapy
harms.note: Reported among treated patients in the initial analysis.

delivery.label: Enrollment exclusions relevant to surgical selection
delivery.value: Bleeding requiring more than 500 mL of blood transfusion in the previous four weeks, permanent urinary catheter, bladder capacity below 100 mL, bladder fistula, previous hyperbaric oxygen for late radiation injury, or a hyperbaric oxygen contraindication.

delivery.label: Hyperbaric oxygen regimen
delivery.value: 30–40 daily sessions of 100% oxygen at 240–250 kPa for 80–90 minutes.

delivery.label: Randomization and analysis
delivery.value: 87 randomized (42 hyperbaric oxygen, 45 standard care); 79 analyzed after eight immediate consent withdrawals (41 and 38, respectively).

reports.label: Five-year treated-cohort follow-up
reports.citation: Oscarsson N, Rosén A, Müller B, et al. "Radiation-induced cystitis treated with hyperbaric oxygen therapy (RICH-ART): long-term follow-up of a randomised controlled, phase 2-3 trial." *EClinicalMedicine.* 2025;83:103214. doi:10.1016/j.eclinm.2025.103214
reports.followUp: Five years after hyperbaric oxygen; 39/70 had an observed five-year EPIC urinary score

results.endpoint: EPIC urinary total score after hyperbaric oxygen
results.measure: Modeled within-person mean change from pre-treatment to six months in the pooled treated cohort, points

values.exp: +18.0 points (95% CI 14.2–21.8; pooled treated cohort, n=70)

results.note: Pooled cohort after control participants were offered hyperbaric oxygen; within-person estimate.

results.endpoint: EPIC urinary total score after hyperbaric oxygen
results.measure: Modeled within-person mean change from pre-treatment to five years in the pooled treated cohort, points

values.exp: +19.1 points (95% CI 13.3–24.9; pooled treated cohort, n=70; 39 observed at year 5)

results.note: Prespecified secondary outcome; after the randomized phase, control patients were offered hyperbaric oxygen. Mixed model for repeated measures.
results.locator: Full text, Outcomes, Results and Tables 2–3

results.endpoint: Early urinary symptom response after hyperbaric oxygen
results.measure: At least 9-point EPIC urinary total score improvement at six months in pooled treated cohort
results.note: Responder status was defined using the six-month post-treatment score.
results.locator: Full text, Procedures and Results, Table 2

delivery.label: Hyperbaric oxygen schedule
delivery.value: Five days per week over 6–8 weeks; control participants were offered the same treatment after the initial assessment.

delivery.label: Control crossover and long-term cohort
delivery.value: After the initial randomized comparison, controls were offered hyperbaric oxygen; 70 treated patients contributed long-term follow-up, and 39/70 (55.7%) had an observed year-five EPIC urinary score (31/70 missing).
delivery.locator: Full text, Study design, Results and Table 2

delivery.label: Follow-up closure
delivery.value: Follow-up ended six months early in May 2022 because of administrative constraints, primarily lack of funding.

delivery.label: Additional hyperbaric oxygen for recurrent symptoms
delivery.value: 9/70 received 20–30 additional sessions at least one year after initial treatment.
